Definition: to flow freely (as water), i.e. (specifically) to have a (sexual) flux; figuratively, to waste away; also to overflow
BiblicalUsage: Zuwb means to flow — the land flowing with milk and honey that God promised to Israel, and the issue that flows from the body in the laws of Leviticus. The same verb describes a land overflowing with goodness and a body that must be cleansed. Flowing is abundance in one verse and uncleanness in the next, and Scripture uses both.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the word shows both sides of flowing: God's promise pours out goodness, and His law names what flows out of us that needs cleansing.
